$comment: The edge's key check alerts (spec 05 §10.2; spec 08 §7.8 group B). The check fails closed: a statement that fails answers 503 and alerts. rate-limiter-failing is spec 05's one alert for the window store; step 15's lookup reads the refused-key window with the key record, so it watches both of the edge's statement failures. api's windows and the auth limiter's limits.store_failed (spec 02 §18.2) join this rule when their lines are catalogued.

alerts.name: rate-limiter-failing
alerts.incident_cause: The edge's key check could not read Postgres (the key lookup or a rate-limit window) and refused with 503. Failures: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The event and the code on the lines (a SQLSTATE such as 42501 for a grant, a connection error code); policy on rate_limiter.failed; database-unreachable and the edge's dbOk.

alerts.name: pepper-missing
alerts.incident_cause: A key names a pepper the edge does not hold, so the edge refuses it with 401. Lines: {{value}}.

metadata.check: Which API_KEY_PEPPER_<n> the edge holds against the console and the worker (names only); the keyId on the lines; the last change to the edge's variables.
